concepts.title: Statistics vs Probability — Foundations
concepts.notes: Created 2026-06-24. Covers: stats vs probability (two directions), what a distribution is, E[X] from dice analogy, variance, PMF vs PDF, Bernoulli, distribution roadmap for all 6 tasks, Normal and Gamma intros. Prerequisite for task1-bernoulli and all other task decks.

concepts.title: Bernoulli trial & expectation
concepts.notes: Deck extended 2026-06-24. Covers probability space, random variable (label gun + why 'random'), measurability, integrability, E[X] (seesaw), PMF, formal proof block, Python code, pitfalls, quiz. Assumes stats-probability-foundations done first.

concepts.title: Important probability distributions (Unit 3 survey)
concepts.notes: Deck created 2026-07-03 (19 slides incl. 3 sub-chapters) after Elena said she was struggling with chapter 3. Organizing frame: every distribution answers one everyday question. Covers: binomial (+ why n-choose-k, sub), negative binomial (flip the question), normal via Galton board + CLT (+ Irwin-Hall sum-of-5-uniforms sub), 68/95/99.7 sigma ruler with the book's ±1σ-excludes-32% gotcha, Poisson (+ binomial-limit sub), Gamma-Poisson overdispersion → NB (two doors into one distribution), exponential derived from P(0 events)=e^-λt, Weibull three k regimes, transformation theorem with rubber-sheet/area-preservation intuition, family-tree map, exam-task mapping, traps, quiz. All curves computed numerically.

concepts.title: Survival function → PDF
concepts.notes: Task 2 survival function: F̄(y) = 0.79·exp(−4y²) + 0.20·exp(−6y²). Flag: ξ5+ξ7=0.99 ≠ 1 (document in notebook).

concepts.title: Sum of Gammas & MLE
concepts.notes: Deck created 2026-07-02 (18 slides incl. 3 sub-chapters). Covers: reading the Gamma(7,θ) density visually (rise × fall = hump), scale knob θ, Erlang 7-stage story, exam normalization typo flag (120 should be Γ(7)=720 — flag like Task 2's 0.99), T=S1+S2 ~ Γ(14,θ) via transformation theorem + convolution, likelihood as guess-and-compare, log transform (3 reasons), MLE θ̂ = t̄/14 = 289/70 ≈ 4.129 TB, E[T] = 57.8 TB. Quiz + notebook map included.
